question: Who directed the film Koozhangal, which won the Best Film award in the Asian Film Competition category at the 20th Dhaka International Film Festival held in January 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**PS Vinodraj ( PS Vinothraj).**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__ 

__
 
• The film **Koozhangal, directed by PS Vinothraj from India, won the Best Film Award in the Asian Film Competition section at the 20th Dhaka International Film Festival.**
 
• Kankar (Tamil: Koozhangal) is a 2021 Indian Tamil-language drama film directed by debutant P.S. Vinothraj has done it.
 
• The film was produced by Vignesh Shivan and Nayanthara under the Rowdy Pictures banner.
 
• Featuring music composed by Yuvan Shankar Raja, the cinematography in the film was handled by Jaya Parthipan and Vignesh Kumulai and edited by Ganesh Shiva.
 
• Pebble was screened at the 50th International Film Festival of Rotterdam in the Netherlands on 4 February 2021, where it won the Tiger Award at the festival.
 
• It was selected as the Indian entry for the Best International Feature Film at the 94th Academy Awards, but was not nominated.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The film **Aina Jhyal, directed by Sujit Bidari from Nepal, received the Best Director award for Putli.**
 
• The Best Screenwriter Award went to Indranil Roychowdhury and Sugata Sinha for the Indo-Bangladesh film Maire Jonjal directed by Indranil Roychowdhury.
 
• Ranjit Shankar is an Indian film producer who works in Malayalam films. He started his film career with the 2009 thriller film Passenger.
